senses.gloss:
उत्तिज् उत्-तिज् (उद्-त्˚), Caus. P. -तेजयति,
-यितुम्, to excite, stimulate, incite, instigate, urge
on, stir up, animate.

उत्-तितीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, about to pass out of (water),
wishing to land.
उत्-तीरम्, ind. on the bank, on land, ashore.
उत्-तीर्य, ind. having crossed, having landed.

उत्-तिष्ठमान, अस्, आ, अम्, standing up, rising;
increasing, augmenting.

1. ऊति, इस्, f. favouring, protecting, promoting, aid,
assistance, help, favour, kindness, friendly feeling, affec-
tion, wish, desire, striving after, hastening towards,
delight, enjoyment, sport, play, distillation; (अयस्),
pl. objects of enjoyment, as food &c.
